svg.aria-label: Original pinhole-detection schematic: in-focus green light converges near the aperture, while more defocused red light is blocked. Historical connection: Minsky’s microscopy apparatus, filed 1957 and granted 1961. This is a not-to-scale explanation of conjugate detection.
